speaker: GRANDMA
text: Having you here again, around this table... Way too long since we all had pancakes together. It just...

speaker: YOU
text: Grandma no crying! I will be making Pancake Fridays a thing again, I promise...

speaker: GRANDMA
text: You are right, love, no crying... Oh by the way, have you seen La Gazetta today? Now that the Eiffel freeroam has landed, car magazine LaStrada EVO is looking for automotive journalists. [YOU], wouldn't that be right up your alley? You've been obsessed with cars since you were little!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: I know you so well... You should drop by, it's just around the corner sweetheart.

speaker: ANNABELLA
text: They say that competition is fierce and sales figures for LaStrada are lagging. perhaps you could be the one to turn things around and revive the brand.

speaker: JUSTIN
text: Yeah, I heard they are not doing too well...

speaker: GRANDMA
text: Before you go, take these, love, pancakes for the road. You'll be glad to have them when hunger strikes.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: And listen, if you're looking for something to do right now, head over to the community center. They're handing out taxi licenses today.

speaker: YOU
text: Free taxi license and pancakes? You're spoiling me, grandma!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: Will you be back next Friday? I'll make more pancakes... and there's something I've been meaning to talk to you about... No, no, nothing too serious, love, well...
